executiveSummary: Today is material because Just Join IT flipped AI Transformation Lead back to PLN/h and added a fresh Senior MLOps Engineer (Google Cloud) plus new Snowflake Cortex AI and AI&Data leads. Pracuj.pl added Capgemini's Senior AI Solutions Consultant (HR Transformation, Copilot Studio), while the canonical Comarch DevOps Engineer (AI-native Stack) page is live for Wrocław; EPAM's hybrid / remote AI-native and security pages remain stable.

changes: The Just Join IT board shifted from a pure salary-currency drift to a broader board refresh: AI Transformation Lead flipped back to PLN/h, and Senior MLOps Engineer (Google Cloud) plus Senior AI Engineer (Snowflake Cortex AI) are new high-signal additions.

Pracuj.pl widened the Wrocław tail with Capgemini's Copilot Studio consulting role and a live Comarch AI-native stack page, which is a stronger canonical signal than the previous purely board-first tail.
EPAM did not materially change status, but the canonical hybrid / remote pages remain live and still anchor the topic's platform and security watchlist.
risks: Board-first cards can change salary, title or status within a day, so the current compensation wording is not durable.
Some of today's new Pracuj.pl cards are consulting or AI-systems roles rather than pure LLM engineering, so fit needs manual screening.
The salary flip on AI Transformation Lead may still reflect a mirror update rather than an employer-side change, so the canonical page should be checked again next run.
recommendedActions: Re-check Senior MLOps Engineer (Google Cloud) and AI Transformation Lead on the next run for title, salary and expiry drift.
Re-check the new Comarch and Capgemini pages for canonical stability and whether the Wrocław wording persists.
Keep GenAI Architect (AI&Data), Senior IT Business Analyst with AI - Freelance and the Svitla Snowflake Cortex AI role as secondary leads.
